about: Who speaks for the ship, and how every voice aboard is recorded. The ship's own calls are in content/announcements/ (one file each: src/core/announcer.mjs); their speakers are the two below, or people. The officers, the leading hands and the officers on the broadcast (the captain, the engineer officer, the medical officer) are people, and each one's recorded voice is the `cast` in their own file (content/people/<id>.json); `speakers` here are the two voices that are not a person: `ai`, the ship's automated system (alarms, fire detection, pressure, the airlocks, hits, torpedo warnings), and `ship`, the bridge's talker (the watch pipes, the navigator, the CIC's fire orders, the bridge talking to a turret). Each speaker's cast is a voice designed with Gemini TTS from `design` (1-2 sentences: age, gender, timbre, accent; permanent traits only) and saved in the Google project; `voiceId` is that saved voice (`node tools/voices.mjs --design` makes any that are missing, in your own project if you cloned this). `style` is the short acting note sent with every line; `label` is the subtitle's name for them; `tannoy` puts their lines through a speaker. `sample` is the line --sample renders to audition the voice. A crew drawn from all over Earth: cast to the 3D body each one is given (crew.mjs deals the people in turn). `nets`: the rooms where a department's net is on the speaker, so standing there you hear what that department hears (the bridge's rooms hear the bridge's calls).

ship.label: Bridge
ship.design: A clear, even-voiced woman in her thirties with a neutral Canadian accent, the trained cadence of a broadcast announcer.
ship.style: Urgent without panic; every word carries down a steel passage.
ship.sample: Now relieve the watch. Blue watch has the first watch.

ai.label: Ship
ai.design: A smooth, level, ageless woman's voice with no regional accent, perfectly even in pitch and pace, without warmth or hurry, like a well-made automated system.
ai.style: A ship's announcer: clear and composed at a natural, brisk speaking pace, human and attentive, never sing-song or robotic.
ai.sample: Fire, fire, fire. Gym and rec. Forward drum, outer deck. Away the damage control party.
